proposed_decision.rule: Adopt 3000 governed core lexical units as the HNK operational B2 lexical target, distributed cumulatively as A1=500, A2=1000, B1=1800, B2=3000, using 30 primary lexical domains of 100 units each. This is a product/curriculum benchmark, not a claim that CEFR officially defines B2 by 3000 words.

governance_decisions.proposal: Adopt the exact level increments A1 +500, A2 +500, B1 +800, B2 +1200.
Adopt the 30-domain matrix, exactly 100 counted lexical units per primary domain; secondary tags never create extra count.

Adopt the counting contract: one governed lexical/conceptual head counts once; transparent inflection, predictable derivation, variants, phrases, bridges, reference names, glossless and dependency-blocked forms do not automatically count.
Treat the existing 53 registered forms as seed inventory only; run a dedicated seed-eligibility audit before assigning HNK3000 progress credit.

Use semantic-slot-first and G-ID-first authoring. Reference languages may inform comparison but never select forms; numerology may organize quantities but never select forms, meanings, phonology or syntax.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-HNK3000-001 through DEC-HNK3000-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not generate vocabulary, approve B16, assign seed-domain placements, or alter L03 curriculum/runtime.
